assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one production game currency icon for Sylve, a premium hand-painted 2D woodland fantasy card game.
Primary request: a compact small stack of three golden coins, with one large coin leaning upright in front so its face is clearly readable. Each coin has a simple embossed oak leaf, a thick beveled rim and a few restrained edge notches.
Style/medium: polished painterly 2D storybook fantasy, tactile slightly worn gold metal, warm honey highlights from upper left, deep amber shadows and a fine dark contour. The icon should sit naturally over dark walnut and emerald forest game interfaces.
Composition/framing: square canvas with a single isolated compact group of coins centered, filling 85 percent of the canvas, strong clear silhouette readable at 32 pixels. Almost front-on with subtle three-quarter depth. Keep details broad and legible.
Constraints: genuine alpha-transparent background, no ground plane, no backdrop, no frame, no UI panel, no letters, no text, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no extra objects. Deliver only the gold coin icon.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one production currency icon for Sylve, a premium hand-painted 2D woodland fantasy card game.
Primary request: exactly ONE large precious green emerald gemstone, isolated by itself. A single emerald-cut gem with a broad octagonal rectangular face, clipped corners and thick beveled facets, shown in subtle three-quarter perspective with a slight diagonal tilt. This must be one solid gemstone, not a cluster.
Style/medium: polished painterly 2D storybook fantasy game art, tactile translucent crystal, broad legible facets, fine deep-green contour. Saturated rich emerald green with luminous leaf-green highlights, a few pale mint facet reflections and deep forest-green edges, made to sit beside hand-painted gold coin icons on dark walnut and forest game interfaces.
Composition/framing: square canvas, one large isolated emerald centered and filling about 85 percent of the canvas. Strong compact silhouette clearly readable at 24 to 40 pixels. Keep the entire gemstone visible with a small transparent margin.
Lighting: upper-left highlights and rich jewel-like internal depth, restrained specular glints contained on the facets.
Constraints: genuinely alpha-transparent background. The image contains ONLY ONE LARGE EMERALD and nothing else. No smaller gems, no second gem, no gem pile, no detached shards, no coins, no pedestal, no ground plane, no backdrop, no shadow plane, no floating sparkles, no frame, no UI, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark.
